summary: A revised discussion of the Pcmail workstation-based distributed mail system, updating RFC 984 after comments and more research on interactive clients and non-PC machines. The design might still change, so implementing it was not advised. It replaced RFC 984 and was itself replaced by RFC 1056.

eli5.summary: Your computer is sometimes off, so a central mailbox holds your letters. This is a better-planned version of that idea, though still not final.

questions: how does pcmail differ from rfc 984
